title: sign(): change signature to accept &[&dyn SigningKey]
description: Change pub fn sign(content_mime, key: &dyn SigningKey, now) to sign(content_mime, keys: &[&dyn SigningKey], now). Return SmimeError::MalformedInput if keys is empty. Update lib.rs re-export, doc comments, quick-start example, and AGENTS.md. Update the single test call site (test_sign_output_accepted_by_openssl and test_sign_verify_roundtrip) to pass &[&key].
